title: Inter vs Club Brugge: 25th of 36 in Europe, and Sky expects five starters back
description:
Inter are top of Serie A and 25th of 36 in the Champions League. Their real season starts Tuesday.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=41

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Inter have no points in the league phase and sit 25th of 36, after losing 2-1 at Real Madrid (Inter.it, Oct 12).
CONFIRMED — Chivu's pre-match press conference is at 8:30 AM ET today; kickoff is Tuesday at 3:00 PM ET, 21:00 CEST, at San Siro (Inter.it, Oct 11).
CONFIRMED — Club Brugge are second in Belgium with 21 points, and the former Inter goalkeeper Yann Sommer is in their goal (Inter.it, Oct 11).
REPORTED — Sky Sport Italia, relayed by FCInterNews, expects Lautaro Martínez, Nicolò Barella, Piotr Zieliński, Alessandro Bastoni and Manuel Akanji to start (Oct 11).
REPORTED — Rohit Saggi of Norway has been appointed referee, with Carlos del Cerro Grande of Spain on VAR (FCInterNews, Oct 11).
